description: Ordered backlog for the Pieces atlas. The daily agent takes the first eligible item with auto=true; items with auto=false need a person.

items.title: 1.5L petrol four: announce it as "Building"
items.detail: Add an entry for the 1.5L petrol four (compact sedans and hatchbacks) to UPCOMING in src/data/upcoming.js with id `i4s`, short, name, sub and done: 0. It then shows in the picker as "Building 1/3". Do not touch ENGINES.
acceptance: Entry added to UPCOMING with done 0

items.title: 1.5L petrol four: draft the real-world figures
items.detail: On the `i4s` UPCOMING entry add `draft` {cylinders, bore (m), stroke (m), compression, redline, firingOrder} using typical real figures for a 1.5L petrol four, and set done: 1. Displacement from bore, stroke and cylinders must match the name within 5%.

items.title: 1.5L petrol four: publish it in the atlas
items.detail: Move `i4s` into ENGINES in src/data/engines.js (copy the nearest existing engine of the same fuel and layout, apply the draft, write `where` naming compact sedans and hatchbacks), then delete its UPCOMING entry. Run `node scripts/engine-report.mjs i4s` and keep torque and power plausible for the class.
acceptance: Engine in ENGINES with every required field
`npm test` passes including 3D, layout and physics tests

items.title: Audit the audio at idle, road and power
items.detail: Check src/audio.js for any state in which an engine is silent or inaudibly quiet (idle, low rpm, each engine). Add a pure function for target loudness and unit-test that every engine at idle has at least 60% of its power-mode loudness.

items.title: Model the rocker arm (roller finger follower)

Add a finger-follower rocker to src/engine3d (name it exactly `Rocker arm`) for engines that would plausibly use one, or document in anatomy.js why not. It must move with the camshaft (follow valveLiftCurve) like the valves do.
acceptance: A mesh named `Rocker arm` exists in at least one engine
It moves with the cam; guard tests pass

items.title: Add Timing cover and Crankshaft seal
items.detail: Add both (system Timing / Structure): catalogue, anatomy, 3D. The timing cover should hide with the first peel layer so the chain is visible after.

items.title: Add Coolant hoses and Expansion tank
items.detail: Add both to the Cooling system: catalogue, anatomy and 3D models connecting radiator, pump and thermostat. Add the hoses to the Coolant tour in src/data/layers.js.

items.title: Deep links: #engine=…&part=…&layer=…
items.detail: Read and write the URL hash so a link opens a given engine, part and layer, and so the browser back button steps through selections. Keep `?debug` working.
acceptance: Opening a link restores engine, part and layer
Invalid values fall back to defaults without errors

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts help
items.detail: Press `?` to show a small dialog listing every shortcut (/, [, ], arrows in tours, space in Run engine, Esc). Make it accessible (focus trap, Esc to close).
acceptance: Dialog opens and closes by keyboard

items.title: Dark theme
items.detail: Add a dark theme for the page shell that follows `prefers-color-scheme` with a manual toggle in the header. Charts read their colours from CSS variables; keep contrast at WCAG AA.
acceptance: Both themes look right on Engine, Learn and Compare

items.title: Engine picker that scales to ten engines
items.detail: The picker is a 2×2 grid. Group engines by kind (petrol, diesel, V) and keep it usable with ten entries without pushing the parts index off screen.
acceptance: Ten engines fit comfortably on desktop and phone

items.title: Loading state and WebGL fallback
items.detail: Show a skeleton while the first engine builds, and a clear message with a link to the Learn tab if WebGL is unavailable instead of a blank stage.
acceptance: No blank stage in either case
Message is announced to screen readers

items.title: Automatic performance mode
items.detail: Measure frame time for two seconds after load. If the device is slow, reduce pixel ratio and shadow-map size and say so in a small notice with an option to switch back.
acceptance: Setting applied without rebuilding the model
Notice dismissible; tests for the threshold logic

items.title: Phone layout: part page as a bottom sheet
items.detail: On narrow screens show the selected part page as a draggable bottom sheet over the 3D view (1:1 pointer tracking, spring settle, respects reduced motion) instead of a long page below.
acceptance: Sheet can be dragged and released with momentum

items.title: Search highlights parts in 3D
items.detail: While the search box has text, dim the numbered pins that do not match and pulse the ones that do. Clearing the search restores everything.
acceptance: No effect when the search is empty

items.title: Export the plate as an image
items.detail: A button that saves the current 3D view with its numbered markers and a legend as a PNG (canvas composite, no new dependencies).
acceptance: PNG contains view, numbers and legend

items.title: Accessibility pass
items.detail: Check focus order, visible focus, ARIA labels on the stage controls and pins, colour contrast, and reduced-motion handling for the camera spring and layer changes. Fix what you find.
acceptance: Keyboard-only walkthrough of every control works
Findings and fixes listed in the PR description

items.title: Glossary tab
items.detail: Add a Glossary section (new view in src/views) with about 50 plain-language terms (BMEP, compression ratio, torque, valve overlap, knock, lambda…), searchable, with terms linking to the parts that use them.
acceptance: Each term links to at least one part where relevant

items.title: Quiz of 20 questions linked to parts
items.detail: Extend src/quiz.js to 20 questions drawn at random 5 per round, each explanation linking to the related part page. Keep the existing setupQuiz API.
acceptance: 20 questions, no duplicates, correct answers verified

items.title: Symptom finder
items.detail: A "Something sounds wrong" page: choose a symptom (blue smoke, ticking, overheating…) and see the likely parts from the `notice` text in anatomy.js, each linking to its part page. Build the symptom map as data with a test.
acceptance: At least 12 symptoms mapped to real parts
Test checks every referenced part exists

items.title: More tours: spark and start-up
items.detail: Add "Follow the spark" (petrol only) and "Start the engine" tours to src/data/layers.js and the tour chip row. Existing tours must keep working for all engines.
acceptance: Both tours run on every applicable engine

items.title: Per-engine notes
items.detail: Add a short "what makes this engine different" paragraph to each engine in src/data/engines.js (`notes`) and show it in the "This engine" card.
acceptance: Every engine has notes of at least 40 characters

items.title: Learn tab: how to read this atlas
items.detail: Add a short illustrated guide at the top of Learn: what the numbers and colours mean, how layers and tours work.
acceptance: Guide present and accurate to the current UI
No layout regressions on phone width

items.title: Split the JavaScript bundle
items.detail: Load Learn, Compare and the audio module with dynamic import() so the first load is smaller. Check the built output sizes and report before/after.
acceptance: All tabs and sound still work

items.title: Unit tests for UI logic
items.detail: Extract the pin de-overlap function, the tour-step filtering and the layer logic from main.js into small modules and cover them with tests.

items.title: Visual regression check in CI
items.detail: Headless screenshots of each engine and tab compared against stored baselines. Needs a new dev dependency (puppeteer) and CI changes, so it must be done by a person.
acceptance: CI fails when a screen changes unexpectedly

items.title: 4.0L V8 (large pickup / performance car)
items.detail: Add a 4.0 L 90° V8 (id `v8`). The existing layout code handles only 60° V6 pin phasing; extend `makeLayout` for a cross-plane V8 (firing order 1-8-4-3-6-5-7-2) without changing the results for the existing engines. Add layout tests for the new case.
acceptance: makeLayout supports eight cylinders in two 90° banks
Existing engines produce identical layouts (tests prove it)
New engine passes all guard tests

items.title: 2.0L flat-four boxer
items.detail: Needs a new horizontally opposed layout in makeLayout and the 3D builder (cylinders lying along ±Z, opposed crank pins). This is a design task, so a human or an interactive session should plan it first.
acceptance: New layout kind `flat` supported end to end
All tests pass; model reviewed visually

items.title: 1.0L turbo three-cylinder petrol
items.detail: Petrol turbo support: the physics `boostMax` is only used for diesels (turbo lag and boost map). Extend it to petrol, show the turbocharger and intercooler on petrol engines that have boostMax > 0, and add the engine.
acceptance: Catalog turbo parts shown for turbo petrol engines

items.title: 1.8L hybrid (Atkinson-cycle) four
items.detail: Atkinson-cycle valve timing (late intake closing) and a simple electric-assist torque fill at low rpm. Plan with a human first.
